rationale: BTC squeezed to 74,779, flushing about $1.5M of OKX shorts at 74.75k, and now sits on the 4H EMA20 (74,575) with the 1H MACD positive and the 1H RSI at 60. The bearish case behind the remaining 1x short hedge is gone, so it is closed before the 74,800 stop gets run. Spot core rides and the freed cash is kept for a DCA on a 4H close above 74,800 or a retest of 73.9k-74.1k.

message.text: Hedge fully closed near 74.59k; futures book flat, ~30 USDT cash free. Spot DCA if a 4H close holds above 74,800 or on a dip into 73.9k-74.1k (1H/15m EMA20). Trim spot on a 1H close under 73,380; resting stop 71,800 for the overnight gap.

lesson.pattern: Hedge against a crowded-long tape while shorts get squeezed
lesson.insight: When the long/short ratio is high but price keeps reclaiming EMAs and realized liquidations are on the short side, the hedge bleeds; scale out early rather than waiting for the stop.
